content: Ligand 1 is a benzothiazole amide on a pyrrolidinone, QED 0.688 and jnk3 0.03 - and benzothiazol-2-ylamino is a fragment I have already measured at 0.01, so there is nothing to rescue. Atom 0 is its tolyl methyl over an acyclic bond, the anchor. Having scanned the azine ring thoroughly, this episode moves to the one part of the pharmacophore I have never varied at all: the anilide linker itself. Every active molecule in two runs uses Ar-NH-C(=O)-cycloalkyl, and I have changed the cycloalkyl and found it irrelevant, but never the carbonyl. A cyclopropanesulfonamide keeps everything that I know matters - a free N-H on the ring, conjugated, with the azine linkage untouched - while replacing the planar carbonyl with a tetrahedral sulfonyl that accepts two hydrogen bonds instead of one and makes the N-H considerably more acidic. If activity survives, the linker is just a spacer and I have a whole new axis to optimise on; if it collapses, the carbonyl is part of the recognition and I should stop treating the cap as free. The surviving methyl becomes the pyridine 4-methyl. Expected product: about 303 Da.
